scope: Final visible Draft; exact source/deployed/article/action bytes; merged November 22 audit record and source history; current article-review and disposition contracts; DailyLogger service/review-history PRs; HouseholdAgentKit PR #1 reviews and P0 issues; core #724 and trust-phase proof rules; and all-state same-source review searches. Read-only review; no article revision or acceptance, finding disposition, action admission or settlement, readiness, merge, workflow dispatch, runtime, or scheduling authority.

findings.title: Run #326 generated the article; it did not produce the audit findings
findings.location: Line 17 labels run #326 as the CI run that produced the findings but links to pull request #326.
findings.explanation: The merged November 22 review record says a Claude Code conductor session performed the review. Actions run 45048728056, run number 326, generated the November 22 article; PR #602 later published the review data.
findings.correction: Identify run 326 as article generation, the Claude session as the reported reviewer and PR #602 as publication. Do not claim CI produced the findings or link the run number to PR #326.

findings.title: Finding disposition belongs to supervised editorial authority
findings.location: Lines 17 and 31 plus retained context say the findings await settlement or a ruling by the independent action review.
findings.explanation: The article-review method assigns acceptance, revision or rejection to the human editor. The review schema records accepted/rejected findings with an actor and evidence, while the November 22 record explicitly disclaims finding-disposition and action-review authority. Action review governs held suggested actions, not article findings.
findings.correction: Say all fourteen findings remain open pending supervised editorial/operator disposition. Keep action-candidate review and article-finding disposition separate.

findings.title: The proposed C6 replay check compares the wrong heads
findings.location: Line 43 calls the replay tree byte-identical to the staged head and recommends git diff <staged-head> HEAD.
findings.explanation: The November 22 review says a direct diff between staged head 3e43c07 and replay head 2d19aaa shows seven intervening review files. PR #592 supports equality of each patch against its appropriate base, not equality of the two heads.
findings.correction: Compare each patch to its own base, or explicitly account for intervening review paths. Do not use a direct staged-head-to-HEAD diff as proof of an empty or byte-identical tree.

findings.title: RETRO-0 preserves a separate owner-step proof rule
findings.location: Line 51 says every PH8 slice must close with a closed issue naming a merged PR as closer.
findings.explanation: Core #694 and #723 preserve two proof kinds: PR-type slices need a merged-PR close-event source; owner-step slices need a completed-status close and are read by hand. A not-planned close fails.
findings.correction: Retain the PR-type/owner-step distinction instead of applying the merged-PR rule to every slice.

findings.title: The service Drafts are miscounted and are not a queue still waiting to merge
findings.location: Lines 55, 65-82 and 97 say sixteen Draft PRs are queued or held on a prerequisite chain and propose finding #576's unblock condition.
findings.explanation: The article lists fourteen PRs: #566 plus thirteen open Drafts in #569-#584. Its cited November 22 finding C8 records that #577 was closed, #578/#579 merged and the thirteen open PRs are review history whose reviewed changes reached main through #592. #577 explicitly says the smaller PRs remain review history.
findings.correction: Report fourteen listed Drafts, distinguish #566 from the thirteen review-history PRs, say their reviewed changes are integrated, and remove the #576 unblock/merge-chain action.

findings.title: The sole open review Draft is #558, not merged PR #579
findings.location: Line 80 says there is one open review-only audit Draft, oldest #579.
findings.explanation: PR #579 merged on 2026-11-22. PR #558 remained the one open Draft review PR at the article source revision.
findings.correction: Identify #558 as the open Draft and #579 as merged/published history.

findings.title: HouseholdAgentKit #1 already has named reviewers and recorded P0 gates
findings.location: Line 82 and the fifth held candidate say PR #1 has no named reviewer, merge condition or owner gate and propose discovering them.
findings.explanation: HouseholdAgentKit #1 contains a Codex review and a complementary Claude review with stated scopes. Open P0 findings are tracked as #36, #37 and #38. Shared GitHub transport does not authenticate the claimed agents, but the reviews and gates are not absent.
findings.correction: Preserve the recorded reviewers and P0 issues, distinguish claimed agent identity from GitHub transport identity, and ask only for any remaining owner disposition after those gates are summarized.

findings.title: Core #724 is not shown to weaken the trust-phase proof check
findings.location: Lines 57 and 94 plus the first held candidate call #724 an integrity gap in the trust-build enforcement mechanism.
findings.explanation: Core #724 names six excluded tests: FleetRunner G0/G6 tests and three skill tests. None is the trust-phase proof script or its tests. The article supplies no native run or source trace showing that check-trust-phase-proof.mjs depends on those files.
findings.correction: Report #724 as a separate CI-coverage defect. Connect it to the trust-phase proof gate only after tracing an affected code/test path or a native receipt demonstrates the dependency.
